格蕾丝的生活方式(Grace's Way of Living): 一篇关于节日文化的B1记叙文:格蕾丝的经历、感受与成长。

Grace usually spends the weekend reading at the cinema. Sam always says that small steps matter more than big plans. On Friday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. A nuclear family fills the little flat.
Sam advised Grace to try dancing as a new hobby. Little by little, things began to change. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Songkran turns streets into water fights.

Grace's dream job is to be a nurse. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Best of all, in Greek myth, Pegasus is a winged white horse.

At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Grace often share different ideas about the holiday plan. What's more, this small restaurant caters for weddings and birthday parties.
The experience taught Grace more than any book could. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
